statement: The pinned Codex core separates model-visible tool specifications in ToolRouter from runtime registration and collision handling in ToolRegistry, then resolves each parsed call to its registered runtime.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Codex core 将模型可见的工具规格放在 ToolRouter，将 runtime 注册与命名冲突处理放在 ToolRegistry，并在解析调用后解析到已注册 runtime。
display_text.en: The pinned Codex core separates model-visible tool specifications in ToolRouter from runtime registration and collision handling in ToolRegistry, then resolves each parsed call to its registered runtime.
